title: eucrosia stricklandii

It is native to Bolivia and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. Eucrosia stricklandii is reported to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds, flu, and other respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesia, antispasmodic, and antiviral properties.
